        try:
            text = convert()
            actual = (type(text).__name__, [ord(char) for char in text])
        except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
            actual = (type(error).__name__, error.encoding, list(error.object), error.start, error.end, error.reason, error.args[0], list(error.args[1]), error.args[2], error.args[3], error.args[4])
        print(repr(actual))
